# 1.2 TB mortality

_Draft! Prepared `r Sys.Date()` using country-reported data snapshot files from `r snapshot_date` and incidence estimates from `r est_date`_


`r lnk("Box 1.2.1")` summarizes the methods used to produce estimates of TB mortality between 2010 and `r yr`.

For consistency with international standards (`r ref_lnk("1")`), a clear distinction is made between deaths from TB in people without HIV (classified as deaths caused by TB) and deaths from TB in people with HIV (classified as deaths caused by HIV, with TB as a contributory cause).  

Globally in `r yr`, there were an estimated `r round(global$mort.nh.num[global$year==yr]/1e6,2)` million deaths among HIV-negative people (95% uncertainty interval [UI]: `r round(global$mort.nh.lo.num[global$year==yr]/1e6,2)`–`r round(global$mort.nh.hi.num[global$year==yr]/1e6,2)` million) and an estimated `r thous(round(global$mort.h.num[global$year==yr]/1e3,0))` deaths among people with HIV (95% UI: `r thous(round(global$mort.h.lo.num[global$year==yr]/1e3,0))`–`r thous(round(global$mort.h.hi.num[global$year==yr]/1e3,0))`) (`r lnk("Fig. 1.2.1")`). The combined total was `r round(global$mort.num[global$year==yr]/1e6,2)` million (95% UI: `r round(global$mort.lo.num[global$year==yr]/1e6,2)`–`r round(global$mort.hi.num[global$year==yr]/1e6,2)` million). 


### `r anch("Fig. 1.2.1")`<span class="red">Fig. 1.2.1</span> Global trends in the estimated number of deaths caused by TB (a) and the TB mortality rate (b), 2010&#8211;`r yr`
<div class="subhead">Shaded areas represent 95% uncertainty intervals. The horizontal dashed line shows the `r inc.mort.milestone.yr` milestone of the End TB Strategy, which was a `r (1 - mort.milestone.vs.2015)*100`% reduction in the total number of deaths caused by TB between 2015 and `r inc.mort.milestone.yr`.</div>

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results = "asis", dev = 'png', fig_1.2.1, fig.alt="Global trends in the estimated number of TB deaths (left) and the mortality rate (right), 2010-2025"}

f1.2.1a_plot <-
  qplot(
    year,
    mort.num / 1e6,
    data = subset(global,year>=2010),
    geom = 'line',
    colour = I('grey20')
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(year, ymin = mort.lo.num / 1e6, ymax = mort.hi.num / 1e6),
    fill = I('grey40'),
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  ylab('Millions per year') + xlab('') +
  geom_line(aes(year, mort.h.num / 1e6), colour = I('lightskyblue2')) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(year, ymin = mort.h.lo.num / 1e6, ymax = mort.h.hi.num / 1e6),
    fill = I('lightskyblue2'),
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(year, mort.nh.num / 1e6), colour = I('blue')) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(year, ymin = mort.nh.lo.num / 1e6, ymax = mort.nh.hi.num / 1e6),
    fill = I('blue'),
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(year, mort.num / 1e6), colour = I('grey20')) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(year, ymin = mort.lo.num / 1e6, ymax = mort.hi.num / 1e6),
    fill = I('grey40'),
    alpha = 0.4
  ) +
  annotate(
    'text',
    y = 0.6,
    x = 2013,
    label = paste(inc.mort.milestone.yr, 'milestone'),
    hjust = 0,
    size = I(4)
  ) +
#  expand_limits(y = 0.1) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = mort.milestone / 1e6), linetype = I(2)) +
  annotate(
    'text',
    x = 2013,
    y = 2,
    label = 'Total',
    hjust = 0,
    size = I(4)
  ) +
  annotate(
    'text',
    x = 2013,
    y = 1.2,
    label = 'HIV-negative people',
    hjust = 0,
    size = I(4)
  ) +
  annotate(
    'text',
    x = 2013,
    y = 0.20,
    label = 'people with HIV',
    hjust = 0,
    size = I(4)
  ) +
 # scale_y_log10() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(2010,2015,2020, 2025)) +
  theme_gtb() + theme(legend.position = 'none')

output_ggplot(f1.2.1a_plot, global[, .(year, mort.num, mort.lo.num, mort.hi.num, mort.nh.num, mort.nh.lo.num, mort.nh.hi.num, mort.h.num, mort.h.lo.num, mort.h.hi.num, mort.milestone)], show_static, pdf_csv_folder, save_csv, save_pdf)
```

<hr />
<br />

Following increases in the estimated number of TB deaths during COVID-related disruptions to TB diagnosis and treatment in 2020 and 2021, numbers have subsequently fallen. There was a `r 100-round(100*global$mort.num[global$year==yr]/global$mort.num[global$year==(yr-1)],0) `% reduction between 2024 and 2025 and a `r 100-round(100*global$mort.num[global$year==yr]/global$mort.num[global$year==2021],0) `% reduction compared with 2021. This further progress resulted in the achievement of a significant global milestone in 2025: a reduction of `r 100-round(100*global$mort.num[global$year==yr]/global$mort.num[global$year==2015],0)`% in the annual number of people dying from TB between 2015 and 2025 – reaching the first (2020) milestone of the End TB Strategy, albeit 5 years behind schedule. However, the decline is still far from the 2025 milestone of the WHO End TB Strategy—a `r (1 - mort.milestone.vs.2015)*100`% reduction between 2015 and 2025.


In `r yr`, most of the deaths caused by TB among HIV-negative people occurred in the WHO regions of South-East Asia (`r round(100*regional$mort.nh.num[regional$year==yr & regional$g.whoregion=="SEA"]/global$mort.nh.num[global$year==yr],0)`%), Africa (`r round(100*regional$mort.nh.num[regional$year==yr & regional$g.whoregion=="AFR"]/global$mort.nh.num[global$year==yr],0)`%) and the Western Pacific (`r round(100*regional$mort.nh.num[regional$year==yr & regional$g.whoregion=="WPR"]/global$mort.nh.num[global$year==yr],0)`%), with smaller shares in the Eastern Mediterranean (`r round(100*regional$mort.nh.num[regional$year==yr & regional$g.whoregion=="EMR"]/global$mort.nh.num[global$year==yr],1)`%), the Americas (`r round(100*regional$mort.nh.num[regional$year==yr & regional$g.whoregion=="AMR"]/global$mort.nh.num[global$year==yr],1)`%) and Europe (`r round(100*regional$mort.nh.num[regional$year==yr & regional$g.whoregion=="EUR"]/global$mort.nh.num[global$year==yr],1)`%). Most deaths from TB among people with HIV occurred in the WHO African Region (`r lnk("Table 1.2.1")`).

```{r echo=FALSE}
plot_data112 <- est %>%
  select(iso3,country,year,g.whoregion,mort.num) %>%
  subset(year==yr) %>%
  arrange(desc(mort.num)) %>%
  mutate(rank = row_number()) %>%
  mutate(label_text = ifelse(rank <= 5, country, ""))


df_shares <- plot_data112 %>%
  mutate(
    total_mort = sum(mort.num, na.rm = TRUE),
    mort_share = (mort.num / total_mort) * 100,
    
    cumulative_pct = cumsum(mort_share)
  ) %>%
  select(iso3, country, mort.num, mort_share, cumulative_pct)


top_5_string <- df_shares %>%
  arrange(desc(mort_share)) %>%
  slice_head(n = 5) %>%
  mutate(
    country = if_else(country == "Democratic Republic of the Congo", "the Democratic Republic of the Congo", country),
    formatted_share = case_when(
      mort_share >= 10 ~ sprintf("%.0f%%", round(mort_share)),
      TRUE               ~ sprintf("%.1f%%", mort_share)
    ),
    country_share_label = sprintf("%s (%s)", country, formatted_share)
  ) %>%
  pull(country_share_label) %>%
  knitr::combine_words(and = " and ", oxford_comma = FALSE)



custom_region_labels <- c(
  "AFR" = "African Region",
  "AMR" = "Region of the Americas",
  "EMR" = "Eastern Mediterranean Region",
  "EUR" = "European Region", 
  "SEA" = "South-East Asia Region",
  "WPR" = "Western Pacific Region"
)

```


In `r yr`, 5 countries accounted for about half of the global number of deaths from TB: `r top_5_string` (`r lnk("Fig. 1.2.2")`).

```{r}
mort.nh.num= global$mort.nh.num[global$year==yr]
mort.h.num= global$mort.h.num[global$year==yr]
mort.num= global$mort.num[global$year==yr]

mort.nh.num.m=sum(Mglobsplt$mort[Mglobsplt$sex=="M" & Mglobsplt$child==F],na.rm=T)
mort.nh.num.f=sum(Mglobsplt$mort[Mglobsplt$sex=="F" & Mglobsplt$child==F],na.rm=T)
mort.nh.num.c=sum(Mglobsplt$mort[Mglobsplt$child==T],na.rm=T)

mort.h.num.m=sum(MPglobsplt$mort[MPglobsplt$sex=="M" & MPglobsplt$child==F],na.rm=T)
mort.h.num.f=sum(MPglobsplt$mort[MPglobsplt$sex=="F" & MPglobsplt$child==F],na.rm=T)
mort.h.num.c=sum(MPglobsplt$mort[MPglobsplt$child==T],na.rm=T)


```


Globally in `r yr`, `r round(100*mort.nh.num.m/mort.nh.num,0)`% of the HIV-negative people who died from TB were adult men, `r round(100*mort.nh.num.f/mort.nh.num,0)`% were adult women and `r round(100*mort.nh.num.c/mort.nh.num,0)`% were children and young adolescents (aged <15 years) (`r lnk("Fig. 1.2.3")`).

Among people with HIV who died from TB, `r round(100*mort.h.num.m/mort.h.num,0)`% were adult men, `r round(100*mort.h.num.f/mort.h.num,0)`% were adult women and `r round(100*mort.h.num.c/mort.h.num,1)`% were children and young adolescents.

In `r yr`, an estimated total of `r thous(round(m.tot.male,-3)/1e3)` adult men (aged &#8805;15 years) died from TB (95% UI: `r thous(round(m.tot.male.lo,-3)/1e3)`–`r thous(round(m.tot.male.hi,-3)/1e3)`): `r thous(round(m.nh.male,-3)/1e3)` among those HIV-negative (95% UI: `r thous(round(m.nh.male.lo,-3)/1e3)`–`r thous(round(m.nh.male.hi,-3)/1e3)`) and `r thous(round(m.h.male,-3)/1e3)` among those with HIV (95% UI: `r thous(round(m.h.male.lo,-3)/1e3)`–`r thous(round(m.h.male.hi,-3)/1e3)`). An estimated total of `r thous(round(m.tot.fem,-3)/1e3)` adult women (aged &#8805;15 years) died from TB (95% UI: `r thous(round(m.tot.fem.lo,-3)/1e3)`–`r thous(round(m.tot.fem.hi,-3)/1e3)`): `r thous(round(m.nh.fem,-3)/1e3)` among those HIV-negative (95% UI: `r thous(round(m.nh.fem.lo,-3)/1e3)`–`r thous(round(m.nh.fem.hi,-3)/1e3)`) and `r thous(round(m.h.fem,-3)/1e3)` among those with HIV (95% UI: `r thous(round(m.h.fem.lo,-3)/1e3)`–`r thous(round(m.h.fem.hi,-3)/1e3)`).

In `r yr`, an estimated total of `r thous(round(m.tot.children,-3)/1e3)` children and young adolescents (<15 years) died from TB (95% UI: `r thous(round(m.tot.children.lo,-3)/1e3)`–`r thous(round(m.tot.children.hi,-3)/1e3)`): `r thous(round(m.nh.tot,-3)/1e3)` among those HIV-negative (95% UI: `r thous(round(m.nh.tot.lo,-3)/1e3)`–`r thous(round(m.nh.tot.hi,-3)/1e3)`) and `r hund(m.h.tot)` among those with HIV (95% UI: `r hund(m.h.tot.lo)`–`r hund(m.h.tot.hi)`). Among HIV-negative children and young adolescents, the estimated number of TB deaths in `r yr` was `r thous(round(m.nh.l5,-3)/1e3)` among children aged <5 years (95% UI: `r thous(round(m.nh.l5.lo,-3)/1e3)`–`r thous(round(m.nh.l5.hi,-3)/1e3)`); and `r thous(round(m.nh.5.14,-3)/1e3)` in older children and young adolescents aged 5–14 years (95% UI: `r thous(round(m.nh.5.14.lo,-3)/1e3)`–`r thous(round(m.nh.5.14.hi,-3)/1e3)`).

The latest year for which WHO has published estimates of global deaths by cause is 2023. In that year, TB was the 13th leading cause of death worldwide (`r lnk("Fig. 1.2.4")`) and the leading cause of death from a single infectious agent. 


### `r anch("Fig. 1.2.4")`<span class="red">Fig. 1.2.4</span> Top 15 causes of death worldwide in 2023 ^a,b^

### `r anch("Fig. 1.2.5")`<span class="red">Fig. 1.2.5</span> Global trends in the estimated number of deaths caused by TB and HIV (in millions), 2010&#8211;`r yr` ^a,b^
<div class="subhead">Shaded areas represent 95% uncertainty intervals.</div> 

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results = "asis", dev = 'png', fig_1.2.5, fig.alt="Global trends in the estimated number of deaths caused by TB and HIV (in millions), 2000–2025"} 

m <- 1e5
dta<- merge(global, unaids.glob, by = 'year')
M <- 1e6

f1.2.5_plot <- ggplot(data = subset(dta,year>=2010), aes(year, mort.h.num / M)) +
  geom_line(colour = I('lightskyblue2')) +
  geom_line(aes(year, mort.nh.num / M), colour = I('blue')) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(year, ymin = mort.h.lo.num / M, ymax = mort.h.hi.num / M),
    fill = I("lightskyblue2"),
    alpha = I(.4)
  ) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(year, ymin = mort.nh.lo.num / M, ymax = mort.nh.hi.num / M),
    fill = I("blue"),
    alpha = I(.4)
  ) +
  geom_line(aes(year, estimate / M), colour = I('grey50')) +
  geom_ribbon(
    aes(year, ymin = lower / M, ymax = upper / M),
    fill = I("grey50"),
    alpha = I(.4)
  ) +
  xlab('') + ylab('Millions of deaths per year') +
  annotate(
    'text',
    x = 2013,
    y = 0.8,
    label = 'HIV deaths',
    size = I(4),
    colour = I('grey50')
  ) +
  annotate(
    'text',
    x = 2013,
    y = 1.6,
    label = 'TB deaths in\n HIV-negative people',
    size = I(4),
    colour = I('blue')
  ) +
  annotate(
    'text',
    x = 2013,
    y = 0.2,
    label = 'TB deaths in\npeople with HIV',
    size = I(4),
    colour = I('lightskyblue4')
  ) +
  expand_limits(y = c(0.2,1.8)) + 
  scale_y_continuous(breaks=seq(0.2,1.8,0.2)) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(2010,2015,2020,2025)) +
    theme_gtb()


output_ggplot(f1.2.5_plot, dta[, .(year, mort.h.num, mort.h.lo.num, mort.h.hi.num, mort.nh.num, mort.nh.lo.num, mort.nh.hi.num, estimate, lower, upper)], show_static, pdf_csv_folder, save_csv, save_pdf)
```

Trends in the absolute number of TB deaths at regional level vary (`r lnk("Fig. 1.2.7")`). The pattern of a fall in the absolute number of deaths caused by TB (including those among people with HIV) until 2019, followed by increases during the COVID-19 pandemic and then declines starting in either 2022 or 2023, is evident in the WHO European, South-East Asia and Western Pacific regions. 

In the Eastern Mediterranean Region, an increase in 2020 and 2021 was followed by a decline in 2022, then by a small increase between 2022 and 2024, and then a decrease in `r yr`. In the Region of the Americas, the estimated number of deaths caused by TB peaked in 2024 and declined in `r yr`. In the African Region, the estimated number of deaths caused by TB has fallen year on year since 2011.

```{r}
dta <- subset(est, year==yr, select=c("iso3","country","year","mort.num"))
dta2 <- subset(est, year==2015, select=c("iso3","year","mort.num"))
dta2$mort.num.2021=dta2$mort.num
dta2$mort.num=NULL

dta=merge(dta,dta2,by="iso3")
dta$rel.red.mort.num=(1-(dta$mort.num/dta$mort.num.2021))*100
dta$rel.red.mort.num.cat=ifelse(dta$rel.red.mort.num>0,"Reduction","Increase")

dta$rel.red.mort.num.fordisplay=ifelse(dta$rel.red.mort.num<0,
                                      -round(dta$rel.red.mort.num,1),
                                      round(dta$rel.red.mort.num,1))

dta$var <- cut(
  dta$rel.red.mort.num,
  c(-Inf,-5,5, 20, 35, 50,Inf),
  c('Increase (>5%)',"Stable (-5% to +5%)", 'Decrease (6\u201319%)', 'Decrease (20\u201334%)', 'Decrease (35\u201349%)','Decrease (\u226550%)'),
  right = F,
  ordered_result = T
)

dta[iso3=="PRK", var:=NA]

dta=merge(dta,cty[,.(iso3,g.whostatus)],by="iso3")
reach.milestone.lst=dta[(var=="Decrease (\u226550%)" | var=="Decrease (35\u201349%)") & g.whostatus=="M",unique(iso3)]
n.reach.milestone=length(reach.milestone.lst)


```



Progress in reducing the total number of deaths caused by TB (among people with and without HIV) at country level is highly variable (`r lnk("Fig. 1.2.10")`). By 2025, a total of `r n.reach.milestone` countries had achieved net reductions of at least 35% since 2015, thus reaching or surpassing the first (2020) milestone of the End TB Strategy, albeit with a delay of up to 5 years. These countries are mostly in the WHO African and European regions. Four of the 30 high TB burden countries outside these regions have reached the 35% milestone: Bangladesh, China, India and Viet Nam. Of these, China and India reached the milestone in 2025. 

At the other extreme, there are `r 40` countries where the number of deaths caused by TB in 2025 was more than `r 5.0`% above the level of 2015, most noticeably countries in the WHO Region of the Americas.


<!-- A total of `r n.reach.milestone` countries have surpassed the first (2020) milestone of the End TB Strategy, which was a 35% reduction compared with the baseline of 2015.  -->

### `r anch("Fig. 1.2.10")`<span class="red">Fig. 1.2.10</span> Change (%) in the estimated number of deaths caused by TB among HIV-negative people and people with HIV, `r yr` compared with 2015

<div class="subhead"> The first milestone of the End TB Strategy was a 35% reduction by 2020, compared with 2015; the second milestone is a 75% reduction by 2025, compared with 2015. The last two categories (decrease 35&#8211;49%, and decrease &#8805;50%) distinguish the countries that have made the most progress towards the second milestone of the End TB Strategy.</div>

<hr />
<br />

Trends  in the total number of deaths caused by TB (among people with and without HIV) in the 30 high TB burden countries are also highly variable. Between 2019 and 2021, striking increases are estimated to have occurred in countries that experienced major shortfalls in TB notifications in 2020 and 2021 (e.g. Indonesia, Myanmar), while in others previous declines have slowed or stabilized.

In `r yr`, the best estimate of the total number of deaths caused by TB suggested that the 2025 milestone of the WHO End TB Strategy (a `r (1 - mort.milestone.vs.2015)*100`% reduction by 2025, compared with 2015) was close to being reached in 7 high TB burden countries: the Central African Republic, Kenya, Namibia, Nigeria, South Sudan, the United Republic of Tanzania and Zambia (`r lnk("Fig. 1.2.11")`). 

### `r anch("Fig. 1.2.11")`<span class="red">Fig. 1.2.11</span> Trends in the estimated absolute number (in thousands) of deaths caused by TB among HIV-negative people and people with HIV in the 30 high TB burden countries^a^, 2010&#8211;`r yr`
<div class="subhead">Shaded areas represent 95% uncertainty intervals. The horizontal dashed line shows the `r inc.mort.milestone.yr` milestone of the End TB Strategy, which is a `r (1 - mort.milestone.vs.2015)*100`% reduction in the total number of deaths caused by TB between 2015 and `r inc.mort.milestone.yr`.</div> 

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results = "asis", dev = 'png', fig.height=12, fig_1.2.11, fig.alt="Trends in the estimated absolute number of TB deaths (people with HIV and People without HIV) in the 30 high TB burden countries^a^, 2010−2025"} 

f1.2.12_plot <-  qplot(
    year,
    mort.num / 1e3,

    colour = I('grey20')
  ) +

    aes(year, ymin = mort.lo.num / 1e3, ymax = mort.hi.num / 1e3),
    fill = I('black'),
    alpha = 0.2
  ) +
  geom_hline(aes(yintercept = mort.milestone / 1e3), linetype = I(2)) +
  #facet_wrap(~ country, scales = 'free_y', ncol = 5) +
    facet_wrap(~country, nrow=6, scales="free",
                     # Use the labeller function to make sure long country names are wrapped in panel headers
                     labeller = label_wrap_gen(width = 25)) +
  xlab('') + ylab('TB deaths (total, in thousands) per year') +
#  expand_limits(y = 0.1) +
  #scale_y_log10() +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks=c(2010,2015,2020,2025)) +
  theme_gtb()

output_ggplot(f1.2.12_plot, hest[, .(country,year,mort.num,mort.lo.num,mort.hi.num,mort.milestone)], show_static, pdf_csv_folder, save_csv, save_pdf)

<hr />
<br />

There is also considerable variation in the case fatality rate (CFR) i.e. the estimated proportion of people who develop TB that die from the disease (`r lnk("Fig. 1.2.14")`). Globally, the CFR was `r round(100*global$cfr[global$year==yr],1)`% in `r yr`, down from `r round(100*global$cfr[global$year==2024],1)`% in 2024 and `r round(100*global$cfr[global$year==2023],1)`% in 2023 (and below the pre-pandemic level of `r round(100*global$cfr[global$year==2019],1)`% in 2019).

`r anch("Box 1.2.1")`



```{r}

#Reload est for PRK share included
load(here("inc_mort/analysis/est.method.rda"))

est.meth.mort=est.method[,.(iso3,method.mort)]


est.meth.mort <- est.meth.mort %>% 
  mutate(
    var = case_when(
      method.mort >= 1 & method.mort <= 3 ~ "Using VR data",
      method.mort >= 4 & method.mort <= 6 ~ "IHME estimates",
      method.mort >= 7 & method.mort <= 9 ~ "CFR and estimates of TB incidence",
      method.mort == 10 ~ "National TB prevalence survey",
      method.mort == 99 ~ "Country-specific customization"
    )
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    var = factor(
      var, 
      levels = c(
        "Using VR data", 
        "CFR and estimates of TB incidence", 
        "IHME estimates", 
        "National TB prevalence survey", 
        "Country-specific customization"
      )
    )
  )


country_counts <- est.meth.mort %>%
  group_by(var) %>%
  summarise(n_countries = n_distinct(iso3)) %>%
  arrange(desc(n_countries))



cm.lst <- unique(est.meth.mort$iso3[est.meth.mort$method.mort %in% c(2, 5, 8)])
rm.lst <- unique(est.meth.mort$iso3[est.meth.mort$method.mort %in% c(3, 6, 9)])

country_names <- cty %>%
  filter(iso3 %in% cm.lst) %>%
  pull(country) %>%
  sub("^Philippines$", "the Philippines", .)

country_model_list <- paste0(
  paste(country_names[-length(country_names)], collapse = ", "),
  " and ",
  country_names[length(country_names)]
)



# Share in 2025

mort_iso3 <- est[year==yr,.(iso3,mort.nh.num)]
mort_tot=global$mort.nh.num[global$year==yr]

category_data <- mort_iso3 %>%
  left_join(est.meth.mort %>% select(iso3, var), by = "iso3")


category_shares <- category_data %>%
  group_by(var) %>%
  summarise(
    n_countries = n_distinct(iso3),
    cat_mort = sum(mort.nh.num, na.rm = TRUE), 
    .groups = "drop"
  ) %>%
  mutate(
    share_pct = (cat_mort / mort_tot) * 100,
    Formatted_Share = case_when(
      share_pct >= 10 ~ paste0(round(share_pct, 0), "%"),
      share_pct < 0.1 ~ "<0.1%",
      TRUE ~ paste0(round(share_pct, 1), "%")
    )
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(share_pct))


light_palette <- c(
  "#8dd3c7", "#ffffb3", "#bebada", "#fb8072"
)


share.cm=round(100*sum(mort_iso3$mort.nh.num[mort_iso3$iso3 %in% cm.lst],na.rm=T)/mort_tot,0)
share.rm=round(100*sum(mort_iso3$mort.nh.num[mort_iso3$iso3 %in% rm.lst],na.rm=T)/mort_tot,1)



table_data <- category_shares %>% 
  mutate(
    Formatted_Share = case_when(
      share_pct >= 10 ~ paste0(round(share_pct, 0), "%"),
      share_pct < 0.1 ~ "<0.1%",
      TRUE ~ paste0(round(share_pct, 1), "%")
    ),
    var = as.character(var)
  ) %>%
  arrange(desc(share_pct)) %>%
  select(
    `Estimation Method` = var,
    `Number of countries` = n_countries,
    `Share of total TB mortality` = Formatted_Share
  )


table_data_full <- table_data %>%
  mutate(
    Description = case_when(
      `Estimation Method` == "CFR and estimates of TB incidence" ~ "Number of deaths estimated indirectly as the product of TB incidence and the CFR.",
      `Estimation Method` == "Using VR data" ~ "Data on causes of death from national or sample vital registration (VR) systems that have been officially reported to WHO (108 countries). For India, officially published data from the sample registration system (SRS), which have not been officially reported to WHO.",
      `Estimation Method` == "IHME estimates" ~ "Estimates published by the Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation (IHME). These are based on analyses of VR data as well as additional data.",
      `Estimation Method` == "National TB prevalence survey" ~ "A dynamic model using results from a national TB prevalence survey.",
      `Estimation Method` == "Country-specific customized approach" ~ "Customized approach used.",
      TRUE ~ NA_character_
    )
  )

table_data_full <- table_data_full %>%
  select(
    `Estimation method` = `Estimation Method`,
    Description,
    `Number of countries`,
    `Share of total TB mortality` 
  )

```


<div class="textbox">
## Box 1.2.1 

## Methods used by WHO to estimate TB mortality 


The main methods used by WHO to estimate TB mortality among HIV-negative people at country level in the period 2010–`r yr` are shown in  `r lnk("Fig. 1.2.15")` and further details are provided in `r lnk("Table 1.2.2")`. These methods adhere to global guidelines for accurate and transparent reporting of health estimates (`r ref_lnk("3")`) and are described in detail in a <span class="red">technical appendix</span>.


<hr />
<br />


### `r anch("Fig. 1.2.15")`<span class="red">Fig. 1.2.15</span> Main methods used to estimate TB mortality in HIV-negative people, 2010&#8211;`r yr`
<div class="subhead"> A country-specific dynamic model has been used in `r country_model_list` to account for COVID-19 disruptions. </div> 

```{r echo=FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE, results = "asis", dev = 'png', fig_1.2.15, fig.alt="Main methods used to estimate TB mortality in people without HIV, 2000-2025"} 




method1=est.meth.mort[,.(iso3,var)]
method1[iso3=="PRK", var:=NA]


f1.2.16_plot <- whomapper(
  X = method1, water_col = 'white',
  legend_title = 'Estimation method',
  #colours = brewer.pal(4, "Paired"),
  colours = light_palette,
  #colours= c("#2c7fb8","#bdd7e7","#88be3b","#c51b8a","#fbb4b9"),
  legend_pos = c(0.14,0.48)
  )


output_ggplot(f1.2.16_plot, dta, show_static=TRUE, pdf_csv_folder, save_csv, save_pdf)

```
<div class="footnote"> IHME: Institute for Health Metrics and Evaluation, Seattle, USA (`r ref_lnk("4")`).</div> 

<div class="footnote"> VR: Vital registration of causes of deaths.</div> 


<hr />
<br />


### `r anch("Table 1.2.2")`<span class="red">Table 1.2.2</span> Main methods used to estimate TB mortality in HIV-negative people, 2010&#8211;`r yr` 

```{r tab_1.1.2}

knitr::kable(table_data_full, format = "html", align = 'rrcc', table.attr = "id='method_table'")

```


<hr />
<br />


<!-- The methods used for the period 2010–2025 can be summarized as follows:  -->

<!-- * For `r category_shares %>% filter(var == "Using VR data") %>% pull(n_countries)` countries, estimates of the number of deaths caused by TB among HIV-negative people were based on data on causes of death from national or sample vital registration (VR) systems that have been officially reported to WHO. For India, officially published data from the sample registration system (SRS) were used (`r ref_lnk("4")`); detailed data from the SRS have not been officially reported to WHO. These `r category_shares %>% filter(var == "Using VR data") %>% pull(n_countries)` countries  collectively accounted for `r category_shares %>% filter(var == "Using VR data") %>% pull(Formatted_Share)` of the estimated global number of deaths (among HIV-negative people) caused by TB in 2025. -->

<!-- * For `r category_shares %>% filter(var == "Using IHME estimates") %>% pull(n_countries)` countries, estimates published by the Institute of Health Metrics and Evaluation (IHME) were used (`r ref_lnk("5")`). These are based on analyses of VR data as well as additional data. These `r category_shares %>% filter(var == "Using IHME estimates") %>% pull(n_countries)`  countries collectively accounted for `r category_shares %>% filter(var == "Using IHME estimates") %>% pull(Formatted_Share)` of the estimated global number of deaths (among HIV-negative people) caused by TB in 2025. -->

<!-- * For `r category_shares %>% filter(var == "Using CFR") %>% pull(n_countries)` countries, TB mortality among HIV-negative people was estimated indirectly as the product of TB incidence and the CFR. These `r category_shares %>% filter(var == "Using CFR") %>% pull(n_countries)` countries collectively accounted for `r category_shares %>% filter(var == "Using CFR") %>% pull(Formatted_Share)` of the estimated global number of deaths (among HIV-negative people) caused by TB in 2025. -->

<!-- * For `r category_shares %>% filter(var == "Using CFR") %>% pull(n_countries)` country (Cambodia), TB mortality among HIV-negative people and people living with HIV was estimated using a dynamic model using results from the national TB prevalence survey. It accounted for `r category_shares %>% filter(var == "National TB prevalence survey") %>% pull(Formatted_Share)` of the estimated global number of deaths caused by TB in 2025. -->

For all countries, except for Brazil, TB mortality among people with HIV was estimated as the product of TB incidence and the CFR, with the latter accounting for the protective effect of antiretroviral treatment (ART). For Brazil, detailed data from the vital registration system on the number of deaths from TB in people living with HIV were used to estimate TB mortality among people with HIV.

For `r  length(cm.lst) + length(rm.lst)` countries with the biggest absolute reductions in TB notifications during the COVID-19 pandemic that were a clear departure from historic trends, estimates of TB mortality in 2020–`r yr` were based on country-specific dynamic models: `r country_model_list`. These methods are described in detail in a <span class="red">technical appendix</span>. For all other countries, the same methods as those used for the period 2010–2019 continued to be applied.



<hr />
<br />


</div>



Country-specific details are available in the [Global tuberculosis report app](https://www.who.int/teams/global-tuberculosis-programme/data#app) and [country profiles](https://worldhealthorg.shinyapps.io/tb_profiles/).

Note : All of the percentage reductions or increases referred to in the text of this webpage were calculated based on unrounded numbers, as opposed to the rounded numbers that appear in the interactive graphics.

```{js, echo=FALSE}
function tb_format_thou_2(n) { 
  //return thousands formatted to to significant figures
  nt = n/1000; 
  return num_spacer(Number(nt.toPrecision(2))*1000)
}

/* Functions to create the figures */

function createFig_1_2_1a(fig_ID) {
 
		$(fig_ID).kendoChart({
			dataSource: fig_1_2_1a_data,
			chartArea: {
				height: 500
			},	
			legend: {
				position: "bottom"
			},
      series: [{
				type: "line",
        name: "Total number TB deaths",
				field: "mort_num",
				color: "black",
				tooltip: {
					visible: true,
					template: "Total number of TB deaths (#= category #): #= Number((value/1e6).toPrecision(3)) # million"
				}
			},{
				type: "rangeArea",
				fromField: "mort_lo_num",
				toField: "mort_hi_num",
				color: "black",
				tooltip: {
					visible: true,
  				template: "95% uncertainty interval (#= category #): #= Number((value.from/1e6).toPrecision(3)) #–#= Number((value.to/1e6).toPrecision(3)) #"
				}
			},{
				type: "line",
        name: "TB deaths in people with HIV",
				field: "mort_h_num",
				color: "lightskyblue",
				tooltip: {
					visible: true,
					template: "TB deaths in people with HIV (#= category #): #= Number((value/1e6).toPrecision(3)) # million"
				}
			},{
				type: "rangeArea",
				fromField: "mort_h_lo_num",
				toField: "mort_h_hi_num",
				color: "lightskyblue",
				tooltip: {
					visible: true,
  				template: "95% uncertainty interval (#= category #): #= Number((value.from/1e6).toPrecision(3)) #–#= Number((value.to/1e6).toPrecision(3))  #"
				}
			},{
				type: "line",
        name: "TB deaths in people without HIV",
				field: "mort_nh_num",
				color: "blue",
				tooltip: {
					visible: true,
					template: "TB deaths in HIV-negative people (#= category #): #= Number((value/1e6).toPrecision(3)) # million"
				}
			},{
				type: "rangeArea",
				fromField: "mort_nh_lo_num",
				toField: "mort_nh_hi_num",
				color: "blue",
				tooltip: {
					visible: true,
  				template: "95% uncertainty interval (#= category #): #= Number((value.from/1e6).toPrecision(3)) #–#= Number((value.to/1e6).toPrecision(3)) #"
				}
			},{
        type: "line",
        dashType: "dash",
        field: "mort_milestone",
        color: "grey",
        markers: {
             size: 0,
             opacity: 0
           },
			tooltip: {
				visible: false
			}
      },],      
            render: function (e) {
            var draw = kendo.drawing;
            var padding = 100;
            var padding2 = 350;
            var element = this.element;
            var rect = new kendo.geometry.Rect([padding, padding2], [element.width() - 2 * padding, element.height() - 2 * padding2]);

            var text = new draw.Text("2025 milestone", [0, 0], { font: "bold 9px Verdana,Arial,sans-serif" });
            draw.align([text], rect, "start");
            draw.vAlign([text], rect, "start");
            e.sender.surface.draw(text);
          },
			valueAxis: {
        labels: {
					template: "#= axis_spacer(value/1e6) #"
				},
				title: {
					text: "Millions per year",
					visible: true
				},
        min: 0,
				line: {
					visible: false
				}
			},
			categoryAxis: {
			  max: 2022,
				field: "year",
				labels: {
					rotation: "auto",
          step: 3
				},
				majorGridLines: {
					visible: false
				},
				title: {
					text: "Year",
					visible: true
				}
			}

		});
}

function createFig_1_2_3(fig_ID, data, category_field, min) {
  
		$(fig_ID).kendoChart({		
      dataSource: data,			
      chartArea: {
				height: 500
			},	  
			legend: {
				position: "bottom"
			},
			seriesDefaults: {
				type: "bar",
        stack: true,
        gap: 0.2
			},
			series: [{
				field: "M",
				color: "#F4A81D",
        tooltip: {
				visible: true,
				template: "Estimated number of deaths in males aged #= category # years: #= tb_format_thou_2(dataItem.M)#"
			}
			},{
				field: "F",
				color: "#6363C0",
        tooltip: {
				visible: true,
				template: "Estimated number of deaths in females aged #= category # years: #= tb_format_thou_2(dataItem.F*(-1))#"
			}
			},
              ],
			valueAxis: {
				labels: {
				template:  "#= kendo.toString(Math.abs(value),'n0').replace(/,/g, ' ') #",
				},
        title: {

				},
				line: {
					visible: false
				},
        axisCrossingValue: min,
        min: min
			},
			categoryAxis: {

					rotation: "auto"
				},
        title: {

				},
				majorGridLines: {
					visible: false
				}			}
		});
}
```
